records.name: ChatGPT
records.description: Conversational AI assistant developed by OpenAI for writing, analysis, coding, image understanding, file processing, and task automation. Available on web, iOS, Android, and desktop, with free and paid subscription tiers.
records.notes: ChatGPT is the consumer-facing product; OpenAI's API platform is cataloged separately. Free plan includes GPT-4o access with rate limits; Plus is \$20/month; Pro is \$200/month. Does not include API access — that is through platform.openai.com.

records.name: Claude
records.description: Conversational AI assistant by Anthropic designed for writing, analysis, coding, document review, and research. Accessible via web and mobile; API access is provided separately through the Anthropic Console.
records.notes: Claude is the consumer product; Anthropic API and specific Claude model releases are cataloged separately. Free plan has usage limits; Claude Pro is \$20/month; Claude Max is \$100–\$200/month.

records.name: Cursor
records.description: AI-powered code editor built on VS Code, offering multi-file code editing, codebase-aware chat, AI-powered tab completion, and agent-based coding workflows. Supports multiple frontier LLM backends.
records.notes: Hobby (free) plan available with limited AI requests. Pro plan is \$20/month with unlimited completions and higher model usage. Business plan is \$40/user/month. The editor itself is a downloadable desktop application; it is not self-hostable in the traditional sense.

records.name: Perplexity AI
records.description: AI-powered answer engine that performs real-time web search and synthesizes cited, conversational responses. Supports deep research workflows, file analysis, and model switching for paid users.
records.notes: Free plan allows basic searches without signup. Pro plan is \$20/month with advanced model selection and higher Pro Search limits. Also offers a Sonar API separately for developer integrations.

records.name: Midjourney
records.description: AI image generation platform producing high-quality artistic and photorealistic images from text prompts. Accessible via web interface and Discord. No free tier; requires a paid subscription.
records.notes: No free trial is currently offered. Plans start at \$10/month (Basic). Discord integration remains available alongside the web app. Stealth mode (private image generation) requires Pro or Mega plan.

records.name: Runway
records.description: AI-powered creative platform for text-to-video and image-to-video generation, video editing, background removal, and inpainting. Used by filmmakers and content creators for generative video workflows.
records.notes: Free plan includes limited credits for video generation. Standard (\$12/month), Pro (\$28/month), and Unlimited (\$76/month) paid plans available. Offers Gen-3 Alpha and Gen-3 Alpha Turbo video generation models via the platform.

records.name: ElevenLabs
records.description: AI voice synthesis platform supporting text-to-speech, voice cloning, multilingual speech generation, and audio dubbing. Provides an API for developer integration and a web studio for content creators.
records.notes: Free plan includes 10,000 credits/month (~10 minutes audio) with non-commercial use only. Starter plan at \$6/month includes commercial license. Professional voice cloning requires Creator plan (\$22/month) or higher. Free-tier output requires attribution.

records.name: Notion AI
records.description: AI writing and knowledge management add-on integrated into the Notion workspace. Assists with drafting, summarizing, translating, and querying documents and databases within Notion pages.
records.notes: Notion AI is an add-on to the Notion workspace, not a standalone product. AI features require a Notion account and the AI add-on (\$10/user/month or \$8/user/month billed annually), on top of the base Notion plan. The base Notion free plan exists; AI requires additional payment.

records.name: Grammarly
records.description: AI-powered writing assistant providing grammar checking, style suggestions, tone detection, plagiarism detection, and generative writing features across web browsers, desktop apps, and integrations.
records.notes: Free plan covers basic grammar and spelling. Premium (\~\$12/month) adds advanced suggestions, tone, and clarity. Business plan targets teams. Available as browser extension, desktop app, and MS Office/Google Docs integration.

records.name: Jasper
records.description: AI content platform for marketing teams and enterprises, enabling long-form article writing, campaign copy, social media content, and brand-consistent content generation with customizable brand voice settings.
records.notes: No permanent free plan; offers a 7-day trial. Creator plan starts at \$39/month. Primarily targets marketing professionals and enterprise content teams. Includes SEO and campaign workflow integrations.

records.name: Copy.ai
records.description: AI-powered copywriting and workflow automation platform for marketing teams. Generates sales copy, email sequences, social posts, and marketing content, with GTM (go-to-market) workflow automation features.
records.notes: Free plan available with limited monthly credits. Pro plan starts at \$36/month. Team and Enterprise plans available with unlimited credits. Increasing focus on GTM workflow automation beyond simple copy generation.

records.name: Otter.ai
records.description: AI transcription and meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings in real-time. Integrates with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and calendar systems to automate meeting notes.
records.notes: Free plan includes 300 monthly transcription minutes and limited AI summaries. Pro plan is \$16.99/month with 1,200 minutes and more AI features. Business and Enterprise plans offer advanced controls and integrations.

records.name: Descript
records.description: AI-powered audio and video editing platform that treats media as text-based documents. Supports transcript-based editing, AI voice cloning, filler word removal, screen recording, and podcast/video production.
records.notes: Free plan includes limited transcription and export. Creator (\$24/month) and Business (\$40/month) plans unlock full features. AI voice cloning and overdub features require Creator plan or above.

records.name: Synthesia
records.description: AI video generation platform that creates talking-avatar videos from text scripts using over 230 AI avatars and 140+ languages. Used for corporate training, product demos, and marketing videos without filming.
records.notes: Starter plan at \$29/month with limited video minutes. Creator and Enterprise plans offer more minutes and custom avatar creation. Distinct from open-source video generation tools — fully hosted, no self-hosting option.

records.name: Gamma
records.description: AI-powered presentation and document creation tool that generates slides, documents, and web pages from text prompts or outlines. Offers smart formatting, one-click redesign, and publish-to-web capabilities.
records.notes: Free plan includes limited AI credits (400 on signup). Plus plan at \$8/month and Pro at \$15/month add unlimited AI usage and export options. Outputs web-based presentations, not traditional PPTX by default.

records.name: v0 by Vercel
records.description: AI-powered UI generation tool by Vercel that converts text prompts and design descriptions into React/Next.js component code with Tailwind CSS styling. Produces deployment-ready frontend code.
records.notes: Free tier available with limited monthly credits. Premium plan at \$20/month for higher usage. Developed and operated by Vercel. Output is production-ready React code, typically using shadcn/ui components.

records.name: Pika
records.description: AI video generation platform enabling text-to-video and image-to-video creation with motion control, style transfer, and video editing features. Targeted at creators generating short-form social media video content.
records.notes: Free plan available with limited monthly video generations. Basic (\$8/month), Standard (\$28/month), and Unlimited (\$78/month) paid plans. Pika 2.2 model supports lip sync and motion brush features.

records.name: GitHub Copilot
records.description: AI-assisted pair programmer by GitHub and OpenAI that provides context-aware autocomplete suggestions, chat-based code explanations, automated unit test generation, and CLI terminal command assistance directly within popular code editors.
records.notes: Provides a free tier with monthly limits for individual developers and free access for verified students. Copilot Pro is $10/month; Business is $19/user/month; Enterprise is $39/user/month. Integrates across VS Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains IDEs, and Neovim.

records.name: Windsurf
records.description: Agentic AI-native IDE created by Codeium featuring Cascade, an autonomous coding agent. Performs multi-file code refactoring, context-aware command execution, real-time codebase indexing, and multi-line tab completions.
records.notes: Native desktop client runs locally; AI agent reasoning and indexing connect to cloud inference. Free plan includes unlimited completions and limited Cascade agent prompts. Pro plan is $15–$20/month. Built on open-source VS Code fork.

records.name: Suno
records.description: Generative AI music creation platform that produces full-length songs with vocals, instruments, lyrics, and arrangements from natural language prompts. Enables genres from pop and rock to classical and hip-hop.
records.notes: Basic plan offers 50 free credits daily (10 songs) for non-commercial use. Pro ($10/month) and Premier ($30/month) plans include commercial rights and priority generation queues. Models include v3 and v3.5.

records.name: Udio
records.description: AI music creation service founded by former Google DeepMind researchers that synthesizes expressive vocal tracks, intricate musical compositions, and stem separations from descriptive text prompts with granular section-by-section editing.
records.notes: Free tier grants monthly credits with standard audio quality. Standard plan ($10/month) and Pro plan ($30/month) unlock stem downloads, extended track generation, and commercial rights.

records.name: Lovable
records.description: Full-stack AI application builder that turns plain English descriptions into complete web applications with front-end UI, backend logic, authentication, and database connections, accompanied by live preview and GitHub synchronization.
records.notes: Free tier offers daily generation credits. Paid subscriptions provide expanded editing credits, custom domains, and direct production deployments. Integrates natively with Supabase for data persistence and authentication.

records.name: Bolt.new
records.description: In-browser AI development environment powered by WebContainers that prompts, executes, tests, and deploys full-stack Node.js and web applications entirely inside the browser without requiring local machine installations.
records.notes: Created by StackBlitz. Runs Node.js runtimes client-side in the browser via WebAssembly. Free tier offers daily token limits; Pro plans provide larger context windows and higher concurrency.

records.name: Replit Agent
records.description: Autonomous AI coding agent embedded in Replit that plans, writes, debugs, and provisions full-stack software applications from high-level natural language specifications, handling database setup, backend APIs, and cloud hosting.
records.notes: Requires Replit Core subscription ($20/month or $240/year) or token add-on credits. Autonomous agent inspects environment errors, runs shell commands, and automatically installs package dependencies.

records.name: Devin
records.description: Autonomous AI software engineering agent developed by Cognition that navigates complex codebases, resolves GitHub issues, writes tests, runs terminal commands in sandboxed environments, and creates pull requests end-to-end.
records.notes: Designed to operate as a full autonomous developer rather than a mere code autocomplete tool. Operates inside isolated virtual machines with dedicated shell, browser, and editor access. Requires paid subscription or enterprise contract.

records.name: HeyGen
records.description: AI video generation platform that produces studio-quality talking avatar videos, multilingual video translations with lip-sync matching, and personalized marketing videos from text scripts and audio recordings.
records.notes: Free tier includes 1 credit (up to 1 minute of video). Creator ($29/month) and Business ($89/month) tiers provide unlimited video generation, 4K rendering, and custom instant avatar training.

records.name: Krea AI
records.description: Real-time visual generation and enhancement tool featuring instant canvas drawing-to-image synthesis, video generation, AI upscaling, and motion video controls for digital artists, designers, and creative directors.
records.notes: Free tier allows daily generation runs with standard queue priority. Basic ($30/month), Pro ($60/month), and Max ($120/month) plans offer real-time generation speeds, commercial rights, and high-resolution upscaling.

records.name: Leonardo.Ai
records.description: Generative AI creative production platform offering fine-tuned image generation models, real-time canvas editing, texture generation for 3D assets, and graphic design tooling for game developers and marketing artists.
records.notes: Acquired by Canva in 2024. Free tier provides 150 daily generation tokens. Apprentice ($12/month), Artisan ($30/month), and Maestro ($60/month) plans unlock proprietary models like Leonardo Phoenix, custom model training, and privacy mode.

records.name: Julius AI
records.description: AI-powered data analysis assistant that interprets spreadsheets, CSVs, and SQL databases. Generates Python scripts in an internal sandbox to render publication-ready charts, perform statistical models, and draft analytical reports.
records.notes: Free tier allows up to 15 computational queries per month. Basic ($20/month) and Pro ($45/month) tiers grant higher message quotas, multi-file uploads, and longer sandbox compute execution time.

records.name: Poe
records.description: Consumer AI platform created by Quora providing unified access to multiple frontier and open-weight models including Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini, and FLUX, enabling users to create, share, and monetize custom prompt bots.
records.notes: Offers daily compute points on the free tier. Paid subscription ($19.99/month or $199.99/year) grants 1 million monthly compute points for heavy access to premier foundation models. Features creator revenue sharing.

records.name: Phind
records.description: AI search engine and coding answer platform tailored for software developers. Crawls technical documentation, Stack Overflow threads, and GitHub repositories to synthesize verified, executable code solutions with source links.
records.notes: Free access without account for standard searches. Phind Pro ($20/month) unlocks advanced reasoning models, longer context lengths, and enhanced VS Code extension features.

records.name: Harvey
records.description: Enterprise AI platform purpose-built for law firms and corporate legal departments. Automates contract analysis, regulatory compliance auditing, legal research synthesis, and due diligence with strict enterprise data segregation.
records.notes: Backed by OpenAI Startup Fund and Sequoia. Strictly commercial enterprise pricing negotiated per seat. No public free tier or open trial. Enforces strict zero-data-retention confidentiality policies.

records.name: Beautiful.ai
records.description: Cloud-based presentation tool using smart design rules and AI generation to automatically adapt slide layouts as content is added. Converts text outlines into finished slide decks with professional typography and color palettes.
records.notes: Requires paid subscription after 14-day trial. Pro plan is $12/month (annual billing); Team plan is $40/user/month. Distinct from Gamma by focusing on traditional corporate widescreen slide dimensions and enterprise templates.

records.name: Tome
records.description: AI-native storytelling workspace that generates multimedia narratives, presentations, and product teardowns. Combines generated copy, relevant AI imagery, interactive prototypes, and web embeds on flexible dynamic canvases.
records.notes: Free tier provides initial compute credits for personal decks. Professional plan ($16/month) and Enterprise plans offer unlimited AI generation, custom branding, and PDF export capabilities.

records.name: Character.ai
records.description: Consumer conversational AI platform hosting millions of user-created personas, fictional characters, historical figures, and interactive roleplay bots powered by custom large language models optimized for engaging multi-turn dialogue.
records.notes: Co-founded by former Google Brain researchers Noam Shazeer and Daniel De Freitas. Free tier includes community bot interactions. c.ai+ subscription ($9.99/month) offers priority queue access, faster response speeds, and early feature previews.

records.name: QuillBot
records.description: AI writing enhancement tool offering multi-mode sentence paraphrasing, grammar checking, summarization, citation generation, and plagiarism detection to improve vocabulary, readability, and academic writing fluency.
records.notes: Free tier allows standard paraphrasing up to 125 words at a time. Premium subscription ($9.95/month or $4.17/month billed annually) unlocks unlimited word paraphrasing, tone comparisons, and full plagiarism scans.

records.name: Adobe Firefly
records.description: Creative generative AI suite developed by Adobe trained exclusively on licensed content from Adobe Stock and public domain assets, powering text-to-image, generative fill, text effects, and vector recoloring inside Adobe Creative Cloud.
records.notes: Explicitly engineered for commercial safety with enterprise intellectual property indemnification. Free Adobe accounts receive 25 generative credits monthly; Premium plans and Creative Cloud subscriptions grant larger monthly allotments.

records.name: Canva Magic Studio
records.description: Suite of generative design features embedded across the Canva ecosystem, including Magic Media (text-to-image/video), Magic Expand, Magic Eraser, Magic Switch (multi-format document conversion), and AI copy generation.
records.notes: Included natively within Canva accounts. Free users get a lifetime allocation of 50 AI queries; Canva Pro ($15/month or $120/year) and Canva Teams unlock 500 uses per month per user.

records.name: Fireflies.ai
records.description: AI meeting assistant that joins video conference calls (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, Webex) to record audio, produce searchable timestamped transcripts, extract action items, and generate executive recaps with CRM integrations.
records.notes: Free tier includes unlimited transcription with 800 minutes of cloud storage. Pro ($10/seat/month) and Business ($19/seat/month) unlock unlimited storage, AI summary generation, smart search filters, and CRM sync.

records.name: Superhuman AI
records.description: AI-accelerated email client for Gmail and Outlook that writes complete email drafts matching personal tone, summarizes lengthy email threads in one sentence, corrects phrasing, and automates inbox triage with keyboard shortcuts.
records.notes: Strictly paid premium productivity service starting at $30/user/month (Starter) or $45/user/month (Growth). AI features analyze past sent email history locally/privately to emulate personal writing habits.

records.name: Mem.ai
records.description: Self-organizing AI workspace that connects personal notes, web clips, meeting minutes, and document files without requiring manual tagging or hierarchical folders, using semantic search to surface relevant past context.
records.notes: Free tier provides basic note storage and search. Mem Plus ($14.99/month or $10/month annually) unlocks unlimited Chat with Mem, larger document upload limits, and smart organization features.

records.name: Luma Dream Machine
records.description: AI video generation system built by Luma AI that transforms text and image inputs into realistic 5-second video shots with accurate physics, coherent motion, character consistency, and dynamic camera movements.
records.notes: Free tier includes 30 generations per month with standard processing queues. Standard ($29.99/month), Pro ($99.99/month), and Premier ($499.99/month) tiers offer commercial rights, priority queues, and higher resolution.

records.name: Kling AI
records.description: High-definition video generation platform developed by Kuaishou capable of rendering cinematic videos up to 2 minutes long at 1080p resolution and 30fps with advanced physical simulation and 3D spatio-temporal attention.
records.notes: Free tier grants daily login credits for generating short clips. Standard, Pro, and Premier subscriptions provide higher credit quotas, longer video extensions, motion brush features, and watermark removal.

records.name: Speechify
records.description: AI text-to-speech reading application that converts books, PDFs, online articles, and documents into natural humanlike speech at speeds up to 4.5x, featuring celebrity voice models, OCR document scanning, and cross-device sync.
records.notes: Free version offers 10 standard reading voices. Speechify Premium ($139/year) unlocks 30+ natural AI voices, 60+ languages, note-taking, and optical character recognition for physical books. Offers Speechify Studio for creators.

records.name: Scribe
records.description: AI productivity tool that records desktop browser workflows and automatically converts click sequences and keystrokes into visual step-by-step how-to guides, screenshots, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
records.notes: Free Basic plan allows unlimited guide creation in web browsers. Pro plan ($23/seat/month) supports desktop application recording, automated screenshot redaction, custom branding, and export to PDF/HTML.

records.name: Consensus
records.description: AI-powered search engine for scientific research that queries over 200 million peer-reviewed journal papers. Synthesizes scientific consensus meters, extracts study findings, and provides citations without hallucinating academic evidence.
records.notes: Powered by Semantic Scholar database. Free tier includes basic searches and limited AI Consensus Meters. Premium tier ($8.99/month billed annually) provides unlimited GPT-4 synthesis, study quality filters, and Zotero integration.

records.name: Elicit
records.description: AI research assistant that automates scientific literature reviews. Searches academic papers, extracts structured data columns (sample size, methodologies, outcomes), and summarizes research questions with direct source attribution.
records.notes: Basic plan provides 5,000 one-time research credits. Plus ($10/month) and Enterprise plans grant recurring monthly credits, high-speed multi-paper data extraction, and RIS citation exports.

records.name: Glean
records.description: Enterprise search and work assistant that indexes internal company tools (Slack, Google Drive, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce) to answer employee questions, synthesize company knowledge, and build internal conversational agents with enterprise permissions.
records.notes: Enterprise B2B software with custom per-seat pricing. Enforces real-time ACL (Access Control List) checks ensuring employees only see internal information they have existing corporate permissions to view.

records.name: CodeRabbit
records.description: AI-powered code review platform that integrates into GitHub and GitLab pull requests. Provides line-by-line code feedback, detects edge cases and security vulnerabilities, generates release summaries, and answers questions in PR comments.
records.notes: 100% free for open-source repositories without limits. Pro plan ($15/developer/month) provides automated reviews on private repositories, custom prompt instructions, and CI workflow integrations.

records.name: Tabnine
records.description: Privacy-first AI code completion and chat assistant for software engineers. Offers contextual autocompletions and codebase querying trained exclusively on open-source code with permissive licenses, deployable on-premises or private clouds.
records.notes: Starter plan is free with basic completions. Pro plan ($12/user/month) adds whole-line and full-function completions. Enterprise plan ($39/user/month) allows self-hosted on-premises deployment, private fine-tuning, and zero data leakage guarantees.

records.name: Make
records.description: Visual no-code integration platform that connects hundreds of cloud applications and databases. Features native AI modules for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Hugging Face to build automated multi-step data pipelines and business processes.
records.notes: Formerly known as Integromat. Free tier allows 1,000 monthly operations with 2 active scenarios. Core ($9/month) and Pro ($16/month) tiers increase operation quotas, execution frequency, and custom webhook rates.

records.name: Claude Code
records.description: Anthropic's agentic command-line interface tool that operates directly in developer terminals. Reads entire local codebases, edits files across directories, runs terminal commands, and resolves complex git pull requests autonomously.
records.notes: Client runs locally as an interactive terminal CLI; requires an active Anthropic API key or cloud provider credentials (AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex AI) billed per token. Executes commands in user-approved terminal sessions.

records.name: Amazon Q Developer
records.description: Generative AI assistant built by Amazon Web Services for software development. Delivers code completions, automated code upgrades (such as Java version migrations), security vulnerability scanning, and AWS cloud architecture advice.
records.notes: Formerly Amazon CodeWhisperer. Free tier offers code suggestions and reference tracking. Pro tier ($19/user/month) adds code transformation agents, higher monthly chat limits, and centralized enterprise management.

records.name: Sourcegraph Cody
records.description: AI code assistant powered by Sourcegraph's code graph that understands entire multi-repository codebases. Provides codebase-aware autocomplete, inline refactoring, multi-file unit test generation, and deep semantic code search.
records.notes: Free Community plan available for individual developers. Pro ($9/month) and Enterprise ($19/user/month) plans unlock unlimited queries, custom multi-repo context indexing, and self-hosted backend connections.

records.name: Abridge
records.description: Generative AI clinical conversation platform that listens to doctor-patient medical encounters in real-time and automatically drafts structured, audit-ready clinical notes mapped directly into electronic health record (EHR) systems like Epic.
records.notes: Enterprise B2B healthcare contract pricing per clinician. Features linked evidence timestamps mapping every generated medical claim back to the original spoken audio snippet for clinician verification. HIPAA and SOC 2 Type II certified.

records.name: Hume AI
records.description: Conversational voice AI platform powered by an Empathic Voice Interface (EVI). Analyzes vocal inflections, pitch, pauses, and emotional nuances to engage in natural, emotionally responsive spoken interactions.
records.notes: Accessible via web playground and developer WebSocket API. Free tier offers introductory developer credits. Paid usage is metered per audio minute of real-time speech processing and expression analysis.

records.name: DeepL Translator
records.description: Neural machine translation platform offering nuanced language translations across 30+ global languages. Preserves document layouts (PDF, Word, PowerPoint), adapts translations to custom company glossaries, and provides AI writing adjustments via DeepL Write.
records.notes: Free web translation without registration up to character limits. DeepL Pro plans ($8.74–$57.49/user/month) remove text limits, enforce zero-data-retention data privacy, and allow unlimited document translations. DeepL API billed separately.

records.name: Wordtune
records.description: AI writing companion developed by AI21 Labs that helps writers rephrase full sentences, adjust tone between casual and formal, summarize long reading materials, and generate contextual text completions across web editors.
records.notes: Free plan includes 10 rewrites per day. Plus plan ($9.99/month) and Unlimited plan ($14.99/month billed annually) grant unlimited rewrites, full paragraph restructuring, and document summaries.

records.name: Wondercraft
records.description: AI-powered audio workstation that turns written scripts, blogs, and notes into professional podcasts, audio advertisements, audiobooks, and meditations using hyper-realistic AI voices, royalty-free background music, and sound mixing.
records.notes: Free trial includes limited generation minutes with watermark. Creator ($29/month) and Pro ($89/month) plans offer higher audio minute allowances, voice cloning, RSS podcast hosting, and multi-track audio mixing.

records.name: InVideo AI
records.description: Generative video creation tool that converts prompt ideas into complete video presentations with scriptwriting, AI voiceover narration, stock video footage selection, subtitles, and music tracks ready for YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram.
records.notes: Free plan includes 10 minutes/week of AI generation with watermarked video exports. Plus ($20/month) and Max ($48/month) plans remove watermarks, unlock premium iStock assets, and allow voice cloning.

records.name: Captions
records.description: AI-powered video recording and editing studio tailored for talking-head content creators. Features automatic dynamic animated captions, AI eye-contact correction, speech denoising, compression, and automated jump cuts.
records.notes: Mobile (iOS/Android) and desktop web application. Free trial available with limited exports. Pro subscription ($9.99/month or annual plans) unlocks unlimited AI eye-contact realignment, background music ducking, and 4K exports.

records.name: Recraft
records.description: Generative design tool engineered specifically for graphic designers. Generates editable vector graphics (SVG), 3D illustrations, pixel art, and brand iconography with strict brand color palette controls and infinite canvas layout.
records.notes: Free tier offers 50 daily credits with public generation gallery. Basic ($20/month) and Pro plans offer private generations, fast GPU generation modes, and full commercial ownership of vector outputs.

records.name: Photoroom
records.description: AI photo editing application designed for e-commerce entrepreneurs. Provides high-precision automated background removal, realistic AI-generated studio product backgrounds, batch image resizing, and shadow generation.
records.notes: Free tier allows standard background removals on mobile and web with Photoroom watermarks. Pro subscription ($9.99/month or $69.99/year) removes watermarks, adds HD cutouts, batch editing up to 50 images, and API access.

records.name: Granola
records.description: Meeting notepad for macOS that records system audio without requiring a bot to visibly join the meeting room. Combines human typed bullet notes with internal speech transcription to produce enriched, customizable meeting minutes.
records.notes: Desktop client captures internal computer audio locally without inviting third-party bot accounts into Google Meet, Zoom, or Slack calls. Free plan includes 25 meetings; Business plan ($10/month) offers unlimited meetings.

records.name: Read AI
records.description: Multi-platform meeting intelligence service that transcribes video calls, analyzes attendee engagement, tracks sentiment, flags conversational fatigue, and generates automated video highlights and recap emails across Zoom, Teams, and Meet.
records.notes: Free tier includes 5 meetings per month with standard metrics. Pro ($15/seat/month) and Enterprise plans offer unlimited meetings, video highlight reels, CRM integrations, and executive Chief-of-Staff briefing summaries.

records.name: Clay
records.description: Outbound sales platform that cascades data across 50+ providers to enrich lead records. Uses integrated LLMs (Claygent) to scrape company websites, research prospects, qualify leads, and generate personalized cold outreach emails at scale.
records.notes: Free tier includes 100 enrichment credits/month. Starter ($149/month), Explorer ($349/month), and Pro ($800/month) tiers grant scaled credit allowances for waterfall enrichment and automated AI web research actions.

records.name: Apollo AI
records.description: All-in-one B2B sales intelligence platform with a verified database of 275+ million contacts. Integrates AI-driven sales writing to craft personalized email sequences, score buyer intent, and record sales call insights.
records.notes: Free plan provides limited email credits and basic sequencing. Basic ($49/user/month), Professional ($79/user/month), and Organization tiers offer uncapped email sends, mobile direct dials, and AI meeting intelligence.

records.name: Sanas
records.description: Real-time speech-to-speech AI software for global contact centers. Modifies speaker accents in real-time on live voice calls to enhance intelligibility while preserving the speaker's vocal identity, emotional inflection, and tone.
records.notes: Enterprise B2B software running on agent desktop endpoints to ensure low-latency audio processing (<20ms). Designed to reduce customer friction and communication barriers in multilingual customer support operations.

records.name: You.com
records.description: AI-powered search and productivity engine that synthesizes answers across complex technical queries, web research, code generation, and writing tasks with live citations, multi-agent research modes, and selectable LLM backends.
records.notes: Offers free basic web queries without signup. YouPro ($20/month or $15/month billed annually) provides unlimited smart and genius research modes, file uploads, and switching across Claude, GPT-4o, and custom research agents.

records.name: Copilot Workspace
records.description: Task-centric AI development environment created by GitHub Next. Takes a GitHub issue, examines repository context, formulates an editable step-by-step implementation plan, writes code changes across multiple files, and runs terminal tests in a cloud container.
records.notes: Requires an active GitHub Copilot subscription. Gives human engineers an interactive steering interface to modify specs, code plans, and terminal verification scripts before pull requests are committed.

records.name: Augment Code
records.description: Enterprise AI coding platform engineered for massive monorepos. Maintains real-time indexes of team codebases, proprietary APIs, internal libraries, and documentation to deliver rapid multi-line autocomplete and precise contextual refactoring.
records.notes: Tailored for large software organizations with multi-million-line code repositories. Backed by Index Ventures and Sutter Hill. Operates via VS Code, JetBrains, and Neovim plugins with enterprise security guarantees.

records.name: Pieces for Developers
records.description: On-device contextual productivity tool and snippet manager for developers. Captures, enriches, and categorizes code snippets from IDEs, browsers, and terminals, offering local offline copilot chat and contextual workflow memory.
records.notes: Features on-device local LLM execution without internet connectivity. Free tier includes local core functionality; Pieces Pro and Enterprise add cloud sync, team snippet sharing, and centralized security.

records.name: Voicenotes
records.description: Voice-first AI note-taking app that records spontaneous spoken thoughts, transcribes audio with high fidelity, automatically formats notes into structured summaries, blogs, or to-do lists, and allows conversational Q&A over past recordings.
records.notes: Free tier permits recording notes up to 1 minute long. Believer plan offers a one-off lifetime purchase ($50–$99) or monthly subscription ($10/month) for unlimited recording lengths, file attachments, and AI memory queries.

records.name: Krisp
records.description: On-device AI audio processing application that removes background noises, echoes, and speaking voices in real time during conference calls. Automatically transcribes meetings locally and produces AI executive summaries across all meeting apps.
records.notes: Core Deep Neural Network runs 100% locally on the user's CPU/GPU without sending audio to cloud servers. Free tier includes 60 minutes daily of noise cancellation; Pro ($8/month billed annually) unlocks unlimited noise removal.

records.name: Castmagic
records.description: AI audio content platform tailored for podcasters, marketers, and creators. Ingests raw audio and video recordings to generate timestamped transcriptions, show notes, newsletter summaries, social media posts, and quote cards automatically.
records.notes: Paid SaaS with free trial. Starter ($23/month billed annually) provides 200 monthly minutes; Growth ($68/month) gives 500 minutes and custom prompt presets; Enterprise accounts offer team collaboration and API access.

records.name: Riverside.fm AI

records.description: Cloud security platform built on open-source Falco that captures system-call level activity to detect live cloud attacks, prioritize vulnerabilities with runtime context, and enforce posture.
records.notes: Uses eBPF to monitor container kernels with near-zero performance overhead.

records.name: Chainguard Images
records.description: Enterprise collection of minimal, hardened, distroless container images designed with zero known CVE vulnerabilities, automated daily rebuilds, and cryptographic software bill of materials.
records.notes: Reduces container attack surface by up to 95% compared to standard Debian or Ubuntu bases.

records.name: Slim.AI
records.description: Developer platform that automatically inspects, profiles, and minifies container images, removing unused packages and attack surface while generating detailed container diff reports.
records.notes: Commercial ecosystem built around DockerSlim; reduces container image sizes by up to 30x.

records.name: CAST AI
records.description: Cloud platform that continuously monitors Kubernetes clusters across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, automatically right-sizing compute instances and rebalancing spot nodes to cut cloud spend.
records.notes: Saves organizations an average of 50% to 70% on cloud compute bills autonomously.

records.name: Kubecost
records.description: Open-source and enterprise tool providing real-time cost visibility and resource allocation for Kubernetes workloads, breaking down expenses by namespace, service, and cloud provider.
records.notes: Now part of IBM; provides native integration with Prometheus and Grafana.

records.name: vcluster by Loft
records.description: Open-source tool that creates fully functional virtual Kubernetes clusters inside a single namespace of an underlying host cluster, cutting test infrastructure costs and startup latency.
records.notes: Spins up lightweight virtual clusters in seconds without dedicated cloud virtual machines.

records.name: Komodor
records.description: Kubernetes management platform that tracks all cluster changes, deploys, and config updates, providing developers with automated root-cause analysis and step-by-step remediation guidance.
records.notes: Empowers non-DevOps software engineers to independently debug Kubernetes incident failures.

records.name: groundcover
records.description: Kubernetes application performance and infrastructure monitoring solution utilizing eBPF to capture 100% of logs, metrics, and network traces at the Linux kernel level with zero code changes.
records.notes: Stores telemetry locally in customer clusters to reduce SaaS monitoring bills by up to 80%.

records.name: Gemini
records.description: Google's hosted multimodal assistant that processes text, images, audio, and video, with integration into Google Workspace and Search.

records.name: Grok
records.description: xAI's hosted assistant offering chat, reasoning, image understanding, and real-time web and X search from xAI-hosted models.

records.name: NotebookLM
records.description: Source-grounded research assistant that ingests uploaded documents, links, and videos and produces cited answers, summaries, and audio overviews.
